Hope Starts Here
A diagnosis is not the end of the road
There are many new approaches to treating cancer in animals of any age, often at costs far less than expected. Because animals do not experience many of the negative side effects that humans do, the quality and longevity of an animal’s life can be significantly improved with even basic cancer care.
Cancer Treatment
Five integrated treatment modes
As a dedicated cancer treatment hospital, our specialists seamlessly integrate these modalities to deliver multi-modality care — the approach proven to achieve the most Optimal Outcomes for each patient.
Multi-modality care
Treatment options typically include one or more of our five main treatment modes, uniquely integrated for each animal. The seamless coordination of these therapies — guided by board-certified oncologists — is what makes the difference in achieving Optimal Outcomes.
Surgery
Expert oncologic surgery for tumor removal and staging, performed with curative or palliative intent tailored to each patient’s condition and goals.
Available At
Orlando
Ft. Lauderdale
Melbourne
Chemotherapy
Individually tailored systemic treatment protocols designed to manage and reduce cancer, with close monitoring throughout every cycle.
Available At
All Locations
Radiation Therapy
Advanced targeted radiation — we are one of the few specialty centers in Florida offering on-site radiation therapy for precise tumor treatment.
Available At
Fort Lauderdale
Immunotherapy
Using the body’s own immune defenses against cancer — through vaccine therapy or monoclonal antibody therapy — alone or combined with other treatments.
Available At
All Locations
Electrochemotherapy
A targeted treatment combining electrical pulses with chemotherapy to enhance drug uptake directly into tumor cells with minimal systemic effect.
Available At
Melbourne
The ACCC consultation
Optimal Outcomes Care Guide™
Every consultation with ACCC includes a written Optimal Outcomes Care Guide™ created by your Oncologist — an Expert Diagnosis and Care Plan with associated prognosis, costs, and schedule. You are under no obligation to pursue treatment, but if you decide to go forward, we can often initiate care at this first appointment.
1
Expert diagnosis
Your Oncologist procures a thorough, accurate diagnosis — identifying the disease type, location, stage (0–5), and grade (1–3) — only pursuing further diagnostic tests when medically necessary. In many cases, treatment can begin at this very first visit.
2
Treatment options
Your Oncologist presents Treatment Options tailored to your pet’s diagnosis, your priorities, and cost/benefit considerations — including rationale, integrated treatment modes, prognosis, schedule, and cost. Your Oncologist will spend the time needed to fully answer your questions.
3
Informed decisions
Once you have an Expert Diagnosis and have discussed Treatment Options, you are well-positioned to make responsible, informed decisions. You will not be locked in — adjustments can always be made as your pet responds to treatment.
4
Care plan
If you proceed, we confirm all elements of your Care Plan — prescriptions, procedures, schedule, locations, costs, and communication protocols. Your primary care veterinarian will be immediately and completely updated throughout treatment.
Technology & facilities
Modern specialty veterinary equipment
We invest in the tools and systems that allow our specialists to diagnose faster, treat more precisely, and communicate more effectively — for better outcomes at every step.
Enhanced on-site diagnostics
Our clinics have access to a full suite of diagnostic equipment for faster, more accurate on-site answers: CT, Ultrasound, Digital Microscopy, In-hospital Laboratory, and Digital Radiology.
State-of-the-art facilities with branch locations
Our larger, modern facilities allow for advanced treatments with convenient follow up available in our branch locations.
Operational efficiency
Digital treatment sheets and cloud-based PIMS/EMR improve team communication and reduce record-keeping errors
Commitment to safety
All ACCC clinics maintain ongoing patient safety training and regular team check-ins to ensure the highest quality medicine and preparedness for any scenario.
Why choose ACCC
Built for pets and the people who care for them
For pet owners
Quicker answers, better care
Increased diagnostic capability means faster results and a more seamless path to life-saving treatment.
Comprehensive care in one location
Chemotherapy, radiation, surgery, immunotherapy, electrochemotherapy, and supportive services — all at a single specialty center.
Modern convenience
Improved WiFi while you wait, plus pre-payment links sent directly via email for a stress-free experience.
For pet owners
Trust & expertise
Confidently refer oncologic patients to a practice solely dedicated to cancer care, staffed by board-certified oncologists.
Advanced diagnostic capabilities
Your patients receive the latest oncologic diagnostics and advanced treatment technologies.
True partnership
We act as an accessible extension of your practice — you maintain control of the case and the client returns to you.
After-Hours Nurse Consultation
Being available for you and for the continuity of cancer patient care is important. Our team of oncology and critical care nurses are on-call at (954) 527-3111 to assist with urgent consultations during these times:
Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday – 24 hours
Thursday- 8 AM to 10 PM
Friday- 8 AM to 5 PM
Saturday – 8 AM to 4 PM
Sunday- 10 AM to 2 PM
The nurse will be able to assist in determining the next best step for your pet, which may include directing you to the nearest emergency clinic. If you have your pet evaluated at an emergency hospital other than our facility, we will forward your pet’s medical records to that facility if needed.
If
your pet is having a life-threatening medical emergency, bring your pet directly to the closest ER.
